definition.description: Patient-reported severity of pain according to the PRO-CTCAE instrument.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical grade (0, 1, 2, 3, or 4) for pain severity from the PRO-CTCAE instrument section of the patient record. If reported as 'X/4', extract 'X'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the PRO-CTCAE pain severity is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: pro_ctcae_pain_severity

definition.description: Presence of symptoms triggered by physical exertion that have worsened in frequency or severity over time.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient record indicates symptoms (e.g., dyspnea, angina, or fatigue) that occur during exertion and are described as progressive or worsening.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if documentation of exertional symptoms or their progression is absent or ambiguous.
definition.name: progressive_exertional_symptoms

definition.description: Patient use of proton pump inhibitor (PPI) medication prior to treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient is documented as taking a proton pump inhibitor (e.g., omeprazole, pantoprazole, lansoprazole, esomeprazole, rabeprazole) from the medication list or clinical history.
definition.missing_value_rule: If PPI use is not documented or the documentation is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: proton_pump_inhibitor_use

definition.description: A binary indicator of whether psychiatric symptoms are documented in the patient's pretreatment record.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence or absence of any documented psychiatric symptoms or diagnoses from the pretreatment medical records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no documentation or the documentation is ambiguous regarding the presence of psychiatric symptoms.
definition.name: psychiatric_symptom_presence

definition.description: Presence of a documented pulmonary condition.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient record contains a diagnosis or a clinical finding indicating a pulmonary condition (e.g., COPD, asthma, pulmonary fibrosis, or other bilateral pulmonary pathologies).
definition.missing_value_rule: If no pulmonary condition is documented or the information is ambiguous, it is represented as 'Absent'.
definition.name: pulmonary_condition

definition.description: The qualitative status of pulmonary function tests (PFTs).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported status of pulmonary function tests from the clinical record, categorized as 'Normal' or 'Abnormal'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if PFT status is not documented.
definition.name: pulmonary_function_test_status

definition.description: Presence of pulmonary lesions in the pretreatment clinical records.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if pulmonary lesions are reported as present in the patient's pretreatment documentation.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of pulmonary lesions or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence.
definition.name: pulmonary_lesion_presence

definition.description: Presence of pulmonary nodules in the lungs.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether pulmonary nodules are reported in the pretreatment imaging (typically CT chest). A report of 'no pulmonary nodules' or 'no new pulmonary nodules' indicates 'absent'. The mention of any pulmonary nodule, regardless of size or novelty, indicates 'present'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no imaging reports are available or if pulmonary nodules are not mentioned.
definition.name: pulmonary_nodules_presence

definition.description: The response of the pupils to light stimulation
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the pupils are documented as reactive or non-reactive to light from the neurological or physical examination section of the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if pupil reactivity is not documented or is described ambiguously.
definition.name: pupil_reactivity

definition.description: Patient-reported score of physical function from the EORTC QLQ-C30 questionnaire.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for Physical Function (often denoted as Physical or Physical Function) from the EORTC QLQ-C30 instrument.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the Physical Function score is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: qlq_c30_physical_function

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
